_comment: xplat API terms that fail to resolve for reasons the page cannot fix today. Read by
docs/xplat/scripts/lib/acknowledged-terms.mjs. Each is printed as a warning on every build, and an
entry nothing matches any more is reported as stale -- delete it then. Anything not listed here fails
the build. Add an entry only for a gap in the data (an index or description that is behind the
product), never for a term that is wrong: those are fixed in the page.
